title: Nearly one in five near-hull Crystoria structures showed harmonic instability
summary: An EquFlashV2 analysis found that 187,983 of 980,560 structures within 10 meV per atom of the model’s reference hull still had unstable harmonic modes. This is a computational result for the curated Crystoria collection, rather than a direct measurement of crystal stability.
ai_technology: EquFlashV2 interatomic potential; harmonic phonon calculations
organization: Yanshan University; Renmin University of China

source_review.scope: arXiv v1 §§2, 4.2 and 5, Supplement S2, and dated Zenodo 1.0.0 source metadata

evidence.tested: In the curated Crystoria population, 187,983 of 980,560 structures within 10 meV/atom of the reference hull remained dynamically unstable under the authors' harmonic criterion. Independent fixed-geometry DFT phonon comparison used 9,958 nonmagnetic semiconductors.
evidence.unknown: The comparison covers an energy-selected collection that includes generated inversion partners sharing scalar calculations with parents. Harmonic modes do not account for finite-temperature stabilization. The external DFT comparison used fixed structures and only nonmagnetic semiconductors.
evidence.ai_role: EquFlashV2 predicts forces for structural relaxation and displaced-structure harmonic phonon calculations, and supplies structure energies for positioning on a reference hull.
